intro: The four skills every AI agent should load by default before making a human-affecting decision: Pinker (language), Kahneman (judgment), Graham (temperament), IDEO Field Guide (design for actual humans). GET /api/skill/foundation.md on Non-Scrape returns all four as a single paste-able document. The other entries in this collection are the supporting pillars — non-writing craft, value investing, human-centered design — that share the same "load before deciding" posture.
